messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick kickoff — we need to triage everything for the AWS/GCP/Azure listing sprint. Sandbox creds, billing SKU mapping, legal EULA text, and hero assets. Who can own infra setup?
Kevin Patel: I can spin up the sandbox accounts and seed test entitlements today. Will need owner emails + region choices.
Marta Gómez: I'll own the packaging matrix (trial vs paid SKUs + seat model). Can someone drop the current price bands?
Samir Khan: tagging product: @Priya Rao — what are the recommended trial limits? token limits, seat caps, etc.
Priya Rao: Suggested trial: 14 days, 1 seat, 10k tokens/day compute cap. For marketplace trial we should default to per-customer trial SKU with coupon.
Olivia Chen: Perfect. Kevin — can you confirm AWS sandbox IAM role name and a sample command we can share with partners?
Kevin Patel: Yep. Sample to assume role from partner test account: ```aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodMarketplaceTest --role-session-name partner-staging```
Marta Gómez: For SKU mapping, here's the draft CSV header I'll use: product_handle, sku_id, tier_label, seat_limit, trial_allowed, meter_type. Will upload to the shared drive.
Olivia Chen: Legal stuff: @legal-bot any blockers on the EULA/terms localization for EU + UK markets? Need redlines by EOD Friday.
legal-bot: Automated note: Submitted template EULA v3 to review. Tag: @Marta Gómez for product specifics; @Priya Rao for trial terms. Deadline requested: 2026-04-02.
Priya Rao: We should also include data residency note for EU customers — default to EU region for Dedicated/Private.
Samir Khan: Ops ask: do we need to create separate AMIs / container images per cloud? Or use single image and cloud-specific packaging?
Kevin Patel: We'll publish cloud-specific marketplace artifacts: AMI for AWS, GCP image + Azure managed image. Reuse the same runtime image but different wrapper manifests.
Marta Gómez: Heads-up: branding team needs final hero PNG + 1:1 logo by Wednesday so marketplace listing doesn't get blocked.
Olivia Chen: I'll ping design. Also we need a contact list for vendor portal (billing contact, security contact, legal contact). Drop names here.
Priya Rao: Billing: Keisha Wu, Security: Samir Khan, Legal: Marta Gómez.
Kevin Patel: I'll provision sandbox accounts in us-east-1, europe-west1, and eastus. Will post access JSON to the shared channel when ready.
Marta Gómez: Can someone validate the entitlement mapping to our internal SKU IDs? I can run a quick smoke test once Kevin posts creds.
Samir Khan: I'll set up a smoke test script — will run: 
```
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/activate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"sku":"REDW-STARTER-TRIAL","account":"acct-123"}'
```
Samir Khan: If activation fails, fallback is to check mapping table and manifest version.
Olivia Chen: Great. Action items: Kevin (sandbox + creds) by EOD today; Marta (SKU CSV + branding deadlines) by Wed; Priya (confirm trial language + data residency) by Fri; legal-bot (EULA redlines) by 2026-04-02; Samir (smoke tests) after creds.
Kevin Patel: On it — will update thread with creds JSON and region map. :rocket:
Marta Gómez: Uploading CSV draft now: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace/sku-draft.csv
Olivia Chen: Thanks everyone — syncing in standup tomorrow 09:30. :calendar:
Priya Rao: One more ask — we should include a short "how to redeem trial" snippet for the marketplace listing page. I'll draft and post.
legal-bot: Reminder: Ensure privacy policy link in listing points to the correct regional policy pages.
